# Shader library reference

<!-- Generated by `jasperengine-editor shaders --library all --doc docs/shaders/library.md`
from the manifests of engine/shaderlib/library/*.frag. Do not edit by hand: change the
manifests (or editor/shader/ShaderLibraryDoc.cpp) and regenerate. -->

The engine ships ready-made shaders, referenced as `library:<name>`. Pick one in the
material's **Shader** row (mesh shaders, per submesh) or in the component's custom shader
(UI, Points, Sky); from Lua set `material.shader = "library:toon"` (and
`material:setShaderParam`, `setShaderTexture`, `setShaderFeature`), from MCP `list_shaders`
describes them. Unset parameters and textures take the defaults listed here.

## Lighting modes

A mesh shader lists the lighting modes it supports; the first is its default (Auto). The
material's **Lighting** row picks one of them:

| Mode | What it does | When |
|---|---|---|
| Per pixel (`pixel`) | Every light of the object is evaluated per pixel: diffuse, specular, shadows, spot masks. | Close-up, important objects; the most expensive. |
| Per vertex (`vertex`) | Every light is evaluated per vertex and interpolated: diffuse only (no specular, shadows or spot mask; a spot's cone still applies). | Mobile, background and dense scenery, many lights; the cheapest lit mode. Coarse on large triangles near point lights. |
| Mixed (`mixed`) | Each light follows its own **Shading** (Light inspector, Lua `light.shading`): Per pixel, Per vertex, or Both (per pixel here). | A main light per pixel with shadows and fill lights per vertex. |
| None (`none`) | Unlit. | Effects, stylised art, UI-like 3D. |

A lit mode in a scene without lights (or with the mesh's Receive Lights off) draws the
shader's unlit colour. Shadows come only from per-pixel lights that cast them.

**Lights per object.** A scene may have any number of lights. For each mesh (an instanced
batch counts as one, by its bounds) the engine picks the lights that reach it: every
directional light, and the point and spot lights whose range reaches its bounds (a spot
also by its cone), ranked by their contribution. The first **Max Lights Per Object** (scene
setting, 1 to 16, default 8; Lua `scene.maxLightsPerObject`) are evaluated as above; the
others are folded into the object's ambient (spherical harmonics), so lights never pop. The
setting picks a compile tier of 4, 8 or 16 lights: fewer is cheaper on every lit shader.
A script that changes it at runtime makes an export include the variants of every tier.

## Blend modes

The material's **Blend Mode** (UI, Points and Lines components: their own Blend Mode) is
Auto by default: the shader's default state (`blend` below), else the engine's legacy alpha
blend. The engine compiles each variant for the blend it draws with (`BLEND_*`), so a shader
needs no setting of its own for it:

| Blend | Factors | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Opaque | none | Solid surfaces; draws in the opaque queue and writes depth. |
| Alpha | src alpha, 1 - src alpha | Glass, fades, soft sprites. |
| Premultiplied | 1, 1 - src alpha | Textures whose colour is already multiplied by their alpha (no dark fringes when filtered). A shader that samples a texture takes it as premultiplied; Sprite reads its texture as premultiplied; shaders that compute their alpha (Particle, Hologram, Rim, Water) premultiply it themselves. |
| Additive | src alpha, 1 | Glows, fire, lasers: adds light; the fog fades it out. |
| Multiply | dst colour, 0 | Dirt, fake shadows: darkens what is behind; transparent parts (alpha 0) leave it unchanged. |

Anything but Opaque draws in the transparent queue, sorted by **Sort Priority** (lower
first), then far to near; Depth Write Auto is off for it. A shader's state may change with
its features or keywords (`@state[...]` rules below): Hologram's Default blend Alpha makes it
alpha blended, Decal's Multiply makes it multiply. A material value always wins.

## Reading an entry

- **Lighting**: the supported modes, the default first.
- **Inputs**: the vertex data the shader reads (`position`, `normals`, `tangents`, `uv1`,
  `uv2`, `color` = vertex colour times instance colour, `rawcolor` = the vertex colour
  alone, `smoothnormals` = the normal averaged over the vertices sharing a position, made by
  the engine); "with X" inputs only while feature X is on ("without X": while off). A mesh
  that lacks one still draws (normal +Y, UV 0, white).
- **Default state**: what Auto resolves to; `shadows off` means the object casts no shadow
  even when its mesh casts shadows. "With X" lines apply while feature or keyword value X is
  on.
- **Depth program**: the shader moves vertices or discards fragments, and its shadows and
  depth pre-pass do the same.
- **Properties**: colours are given in sRGB as edited (stored linear); "with X" rows show
  only while feature X is on. **Features** are compile-time switches (no cost when off);
  **keywords** pick one value of a group (the first is the default; the define is
  `<GROUP>_<VALUE>`).

## Basic

<a id="libraryunlit"></a>
### Unlit (`library:unlit`)

Base colour times base map, optionally times vertex colour, without lighting; optional alpha clip, whose shadows are cut out too.

- **Type**: mesh (a material's shader); category Basic.
- **Lighting**: none.
- **Inputs**: `uv1`, `color`.
- **Default state**: blend opaque.
- **Depth program**: yes (shadows and depth follow its vertices and clipping).

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `baseColor` | colour | (1, 1, 1, 1) | Base colour |
| `tiling` | vector4 | (1, 1, 0, 0) | Tiling (xy) and offset (zw) |
| `alphaCutoff` | range 0 to 1 | 0.5 | Alpha cutoff (with `ALPHA_CLIP`) |

| Texture | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `u_baseTexture` | white | Base map |

| Feature | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `VERTEX_COLOR` | off | Vertex colour |
| `ALPHA_CLIP` | off | Alpha clip |

## Lit

<a id="librarysimple_lit"></a>
### Simple Lit (`library:simple_lit`)

Blinn-Phong lighting: diffuse from every light, specular and shadows from the pixel lights, optional normal map and emission. The mobile tier of Lit.

- **Type**: mesh (a material's shader); category Lit.
- **Lighting**: per pixel (default), per vertex, mixed.
- **Inputs**: `uv1`, `color`.
- **Default state**: blend opaque.
- **Depth program**: no (the built-in one).

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `baseColor` | colour | (1, 1, 1, 1) | Base colour |
| `tiling` | vector4 | (1, 1, 0, 0) | Tiling (xy) and offset (zw) |
| `specularColor` | colour | (0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 1) | Specular colour |
| `gloss` | range 0 to 1 | 0.5 | Glossiness |
| `normalStrength` | range 0 to 2 | 1 | Normal strength (with `NORMAL_MAP`) |
| `emissionColor` | HDR colour | (1, 1, 1, 1) | Emission colour (with `EMISSION`) |

| Texture | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `u_baseTexture` | white | Base map |
| `u_normalTexture` | flat normal | Normal map (with `NORMAL_MAP`) |
| `u_emissionTexture` | white | Emission map (with `EMISSION`) |

| Feature | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `VERTEX_COLOR` | off | Vertex colour |
| `NORMAL_MAP` | off | Normal map |
| `EMISSION` | off | Emission |

<a id="libraryvertex_lit"></a>
### Vertex Lit (`library:vertex_lit`)

Base colour times base map, lit per vertex: the ambient plus the diffuse of the object's lights. The cheapest lit shader.

- **Type**: mesh (a material's shader); category Lit.
- **Lighting**: per vertex (default).
- **Inputs**: `uv1`, `color`.
- **Default state**: blend opaque.
- **Depth program**: no (the built-in one).

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `baseColor` | colour | (1, 1, 1, 1) | Base colour |
| `tiling` | vector4 | (1, 1, 0, 0) | Tiling (xy) and offset (zw) |
| `emissionColor` | HDR colour | (1, 1, 1, 1) | Emission colour (with `EMISSION`) |

| Texture | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `u_baseTexture` | white | Base map |
| `u_emissionTexture` | white | Emission map (with `EMISSION`) |

| Feature | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `VERTEX_COLOR` | off | Vertex colour |
| `EMISSION` | off | Emission |

## Stylized

<a id="librarydirectional_tint"></a>
### Directional Tint (`library:directional_tint`)

Kenney's directional tint: one colour per world axis, blended by the world normal, times the base map. Unlit. White in all three colours is neutral, Kenney's original defaults; the defaults here are a sample tint (warm tops, purple and red sides).

- **Type**: mesh (a material's shader); category Stylized.
- **Lighting**: none.
- **Inputs**: `normals`, `uv1`.
- **Default state**: blend opaque.
- **Depth program**: no (the built-in one).

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | colour | (1, 1, 1, 1) | Colour (multiplies all three) |
| `colorA` | colour | (1, 0.78, 0.25, 1) | Colour A (faces along Y: top, bottom) |
| `colorB` | colour | (0.56, 0.33, 0.86, 1) | Colour B (faces along X) |
| `colorC` | colour | (0.92, 0.26, 0.3, 1) | Colour C (faces along Z) |
| `tiling` | vector4 | (1, 1, 0, 0) | Tiling (xy) and offset (zw) |

| Texture | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `u_baseTexture` | white | Base map |

<a id="libraryfake_lit"></a>
### Fake Lit (`library:fake_lit`)

Lighting faked without lights: surfaces facing down and away from the camera blend to a shadow colour, with optional matcap shine, baked shadow texture, vertex AO, emission and axis fog. Cheap; no scene lights needed.

- **Type**: mesh (a material's shader); category Stylized.
- **Lighting**: none (default), per vertex.
- **Inputs**: `position`, `normals`, `uv1`, `color`; `uv2` with `SHADOW_TEXTURE`; `rawcolor` with `VERTEX_AO`.
- **Default state**: blend opaque.
- **Depth program**: no (the built-in one).

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `baseColor` | colour | (1, 1, 1, 1) | Tint |
| `tiling` | vector4 | (1, 1, 0, 0) | Tiling (xy) and offset (zw) |
| `shadowColor` | colour | (0.36, 0.33, 0.52, 1) | Shadow colour |
| `shadowPower` | range 0.1 to 8 | 1.5 | Downward shadow power |
| `shadowStrength` | range 0 to 2 | 0.6 | Downward shadow strength |
| `rimScale` | range 0 to 2 | 0.5 | Edge shadow scale |
| `rimPower` | range 0.1 to 8 | 2.5 | Edge shadow power |
| `matcapGain` | range 0 to 4 | 1 | Matcap gain (with `MATCAP`) |
| `matcapPower` | range 0.1 to 8 | 1 | Matcap power (with `MATCAP`) |
| `shadowTextureStrength` | range 0 to 2 | 1 | Shadow texture strength (with `SHADOW_TEXTURE`) |
| `aoStrength` | range 0 to 2 | 1 | Vertex AO strength (with `VERTEX_AO`) |
| `emissionColor` | HDR colour | (1, 1, 1, 1) | Emission colour (with `EMISSION`) |
| `fogColor` | colour | (0.62, 0.78, 0.95, 1) | Axis fog colour (with `AXIS_FOG`) |
| `fogAxis` | vector3 | (0, 0, -1) | Axis fog direction (world, unit length) (with `AXIS_FOG`) |
| `fogStart` | float | 6 | Axis fog start (from the camera) (with `AXIS_FOG`) |
| `fogLength` | float | 20 | Axis fog length (with `AXIS_FOG`) |

| Texture | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `u_baseTexture` | white | Base map |
| `u_matcapTexture` | black | Matcap (with `MATCAP`) |
| `u_shadowTexture` | white | Shadow texture (red, 1 = lit; UV2, else UV1) (with `SHADOW_TEXTURE`) |
| `u_emissionTexture` | white | Emission map (with `EMISSION`) |

| Feature | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `MATCAP` | off | Matcap shine |
| `SHADOW_TEXTURE` | off | Baked shadow texture |
| `VERTEX_AO` | off | Vertex colour AO (red) |
| `EMISSION` | off | Emission |
| `AXIS_FOG` | off | Axis fog |

<a id="librarymatcap"></a>
### Matcap (`library:matcap`)

Material capture: the colour comes from a matcap image looked up by the view-space normal, replacing, multiplying or adding to the base map. Assign a matcap image (ADD wants a shine matcap, mostly black: the default white one adds full white); unlit.

- **Type**: mesh (a material's shader); category Stylized.
- **Lighting**: none.
- **Inputs**: `position`, `normals`, `color`; `uv1` without `MATCAP_MODE_REPLACE`.
- **Default state**: blend opaque.
- **Depth program**: no (the built-in one).

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `baseColor` | colour | (1, 1, 1, 1) | Tint |
| `tiling` | vector4 | (1, 1, 0, 0) | Tiling (xy) and offset (zw) (without `MATCAP_MODE_REPLACE`) |
| `matcapGain` | range 0 to 4 | 1 | Matcap gain |
| `matcapPower` | range 0.1 to 8 | 1 | Matcap power |
| `rimColor` | HDR colour | (1, 1, 1, 1) | Rim colour (with `RIM`) |
| `rimPower` | range 0.5 to 16 | 4 | Rim power (with `RIM`) |

| Texture | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `u_matcapTexture` | white | Matcap |
| `u_baseTexture` | white | Base map (without `MATCAP_MODE_REPLACE`) |

| Feature | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `RIM` | off | Rim light |

| Keyword group | Values (first is the default) | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `MATCAP_MODE` | `MATCAP_MODE_REPLACE`, `MATCAP_MODE_MULTIPLY`, `MATCAP_MODE_ADD` | Mode |

<a id="librarytoon"></a>
### Toon (`library:toon`)

Cel shading: the light falls in hard bands (or follows a ramp texture), the unlit side takes a shadow colour, with optional hard specular highlight and rim light. Receives shadows.

- **Type**: mesh (a material's shader); category Stylized.
- **Lighting**: per pixel (default), mixed, per vertex.
- **Inputs**: `uv1`, `color`; `position`, `normals` with `RIM`.
- **Default state**: blend opaque.
- **Depth program**: no (the built-in one).

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `baseColor` | colour | (1, 1, 1, 1) | Base colour |
| `tiling` | vector4 | (1, 1, 0, 0) | Tiling (xy) and offset (zw) |
| `shadowColor` | colour | (0.42, 0.38, 0.62, 1) | Shadow colour (unlit side fill) |
| `bands` | range 1 to 8 | 2 | Bands |
| `bandSmoothness` | range 0 to 1 | 0.08 | Band edge width |
| `specularColor` | HDR colour | (1, 1, 1, 1) | Specular colour (with `SPECULAR`) |
| `specularSize` | range 0 to 1 | 0.3 | Specular size (with `SPECULAR`) |
| `specularSmoothness` | range 0 to 1 | 0.15 | Specular edge width (with `SPECULAR`) |
| `rimColor` | HDR colour | (0.75, 0.75, 0.75, 1) | Rim colour (with `RIM`) |
| `rimPower` | range 0.5 to 16 | 4 | Rim power (with `RIM`) |
| `rimSmoothness` | range 0 to 1 | 0.1 | Rim edge width (with `RIM`) |
| `rimLitOnly` | toggle | on | Rim on the lit side only (with `RIM`) |

| Texture | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `u_baseTexture` | white | Base map |
| `u_rampTexture` | white | Ramp (left unlit, right lit) (with `RAMP`) |

| Feature | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `RAMP` | off | Ramp texture |
| `SPECULAR` | off | Specular highlight |
| `RIM` | off | Rim light |

<a id="librarytriplanar"></a>
### Triplanar (`library:triplanar`)

Projects a texture along the three axes and blends by the normal, so meshes need no UVs and tiling stays even. Optional separate floor and ceiling textures and a dirt overlay. Unlit or Lambert lit.

- **Type**: mesh (a material's shader); category Stylized.
- **Lighting**: none (default), per pixel, per vertex.
- **Inputs**: `position`, `normals`, `color`.
- **Default state**: blend opaque.
- **Depth program**: no (the built-in one).

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `baseColor` | colour | (1, 1, 1, 1) | Tint |
| `tiling` | float | 1 | Tiling (repeats per unit) |
| `sharpness` | range 1 to 16 | 4 | Blend sharpness |
| `noiseTiling` | float | 0.15 | Dirt noise tiling (repeats per unit) (with `NOISE_MASK`) |
| `dirtColor` | colour | (0.23, 0.17, 0.11, 1) | Dirt colour (with `NOISE_MASK`) |
| `dirtStrength` | range 0 to 1 | 0.65 | Dirt strength (with `NOISE_MASK`) |
| `dirtContrast` | range 0.5 to 8 | 2.5 | Dirt contrast (with `NOISE_MASK`) |

| Texture | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `u_baseTexture` | white | Texture (walls with TOP_BOTTOM) |
| `u_topTexture` | white | Floor texture (faces up) (with `TOP_BOTTOM`) |
| `u_bottomTexture` | white | Ceiling texture (faces down) (with `TOP_BOTTOM`) |
| `u_noiseTexture` | white | Dirt noise (red) (with `NOISE_MASK`) |

| Feature | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `TOP_BOTTOM` | off | Separate floor and ceiling textures |
| `NOISE_MASK` | off | Dirt overlay |

| Keyword group | Values (first is the default) | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SPACE` | `SPACE_WORLD`, `SPACE_OBJECT` | Space |

<a id="libraryvertex_color"></a>
### Vertex Color (`library:vertex_color`)

The mesh's vertex colours times a tint, optionally times a texture. Unlit, or Lambert lit per vertex or per pixel.

- **Type**: mesh (a material's shader); category Stylized.
- **Lighting**: none (default), per vertex, per pixel.
- **Inputs**: `color`; `uv1` with `TEXTURE`.
- **Default state**: blend opaque.
- **Depth program**: no (the built-in one).

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `baseColor` | colour | (1, 1, 1, 1) | Tint |
| `tiling` | vector4 | (1, 1, 0, 0) | Tiling (xy) and offset (zw) (with `TEXTURE`) |

| Texture | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `u_baseTexture` | white | Texture (with `TEXTURE`) |

| Feature | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `TEXTURE` | off | Texture |

## Effects

<a id="librarydecal"></a>
### Decal (`library:decal`)

Mesh decal: texture times tint on a quad laid on a surface, alpha blended, pulled towards the camera by a depth offset so it does not z-fight; no shadows. Default blend Multiply darkens what is under it instead (dirt, fake shadows).

- **Type**: mesh (a material's shader); category Effects.
- **Lighting**: none.
- **Inputs**: `uv1`, `color`.
- **Default state**: blend alpha, depth write off, depth offset -1, -1, shadows off; with `DECAL_BLEND_MULTIPLY`: blend multiply.
- **Depth program**: no (the built-in one).

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tint` | colour | (1, 1, 1, 1) | Tint |
| `tiling` | vector4 | (1, 1, 0, 0) | Tiling (xy) and offset (zw) |
| `opacity` | range 0 to 1 | 1 | Opacity |

| Texture | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `u_baseTexture` | white | Decal |

| Feature | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `VERTEX_COLOR` | off | Vertex colour |

| Keyword group | Values (first is the default) | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `DECAL_BLEND` | `DECAL_BLEND_ALPHA`, `DECAL_BLEND_MULTIPLY` | Default blend |

<a id="librarydissolve"></a>
### Dissolve (`library:dissolve`)

Burns the surface away where a noise texture is below the cutoff, with a glowing edge band; both faces drawn, so the inside shows through the holes. Shadows get the same holes.

- **Type**: mesh (a material's shader); category Effects.
- **Lighting**: none (default), per pixel.
- **Inputs**: `uv1`, `color`; `normals` with `WORLD_NOISE`.
- **Default state**: blend opaque, cull off (both faces).
- **Depth program**: yes (shadows and depth follow its vertices and clipping).

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `baseColor` | colour | (1, 1, 1, 1) | Base colour |
| `tiling` | vector4 | (1, 1, 0, 0) | Tiling (xy) and offset (zw) |
| `cutoff` | range 0 to 1 | 0.35 | Cutoff (0 whole, 1 gone) |
| `edgeWidth` | range 0 to 0.5 | 0.08 | Edge width (noise units) |
| `edgeColor` | HDR colour | (2.5, 1.2, 0.35, 1) | Edge colour |
| `noiseTiling` | vector4 | (1, 1, 0, 0) | Noise tiling (xy) and offset (zw) |
| `worldNoiseScale` | float | 0.6 | Noise tiles per world unit (with `WORLD_NOISE`) |

| Texture | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `u_baseTexture` | white | Base map |
| `u_noiseTexture` | gray | Noise (red) |

| Feature | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `WORLD_NOISE` | off | World-space noise |
| `VERTEX_COLOR` | off | Vertex colour |

<a id="libraryflipbook"></a>
### Flipbook (`library:flipbook`)

Sprite-sheet animation on a mesh: plays the frames of a columns x rows sheet at a frame rate, looping or holding the last frame, optionally crossfading between frames. Alpha blended by default; alpha clip for opaque cutouts, which also cast shadows of the frame's shape.

- **Type**: mesh (a material's shader); category Effects.
- **Lighting**: none.
- **Inputs**: `uv1`, `color`.
- **Default state**: blend alpha; without `ALPHA_CLIP`: shadows off.
- **Depth program**: yes (shadows and depth follow its vertices and clipping).

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tint` | HDR colour | (1, 1, 1, 1) | Tint |
| `columns` | int | 4 | Columns |
| `rows` | int | 4 | Rows |
| `fps` | float | 12 | Frames per second (negative: backwards) |
| `startFrame` | int | 0 | First frame |
| `frameCount` | int | 0 | Frame count (0: to the end of the sheet) |
| `loop` | toggle | on | Loop (off: hold the last frame) |
| `startTime` | float | 0 | Start time (seconds of the engine clock, Lua Engine.systemTime) |
| `alphaCutoff` | range 0 to 1 | 0.5 | Alpha cutoff (with `ALPHA_CLIP`) |

| Texture | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `u_sheetTexture` | white | Sprite sheet |

| Feature | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `FRAME_BLEND` | off | Crossfade frames |
| `ALPHA_CLIP` | off | Alpha clip |
| `VERTEX_COLOR` | off | Vertex colour |

<a id="libraryhologram"></a>
### Hologram (`library:hologram`)

Sci-fi hologram: scanlines scrolling along world Y (procedural or from a texture), fresnel rim and flicker, in a tint. Additive by default (Default blend Alpha: alpha blended); no depth write, no shadows.

- **Type**: mesh (a material's shader); category Effects.
- **Lighting**: none.
- **Inputs**: `position`, `normals`.
- **Default state**: blend additive, depth write off, shadows off; with `BLEND_MODE_ALPHA`: blend alpha.
- **Depth program**: no (the built-in one).

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tint` | HDR colour | (0.3, 0.9, 1, 1) | Tint |

<a id="librarysprite_mask"></a>
### Sprite mask (`library:sprite_mask`)

Unity-style Sprite Mask: writes stencil 16 (bits 0xF0) in the shape of the sprite's own image (its texture rect or atlas frame; texels below the alpha cutoff write nothing), and no colour or depth. Put it on a Sprite (Sprite mask preset); sprites with the Visible inside mask preset (stencil equal 16) show only inside it, Visible outside mask (not equal) only outside. In a 3D or distance-sorted camera the mask (opaque queue) draws before the blended sprites; in a 2D camera that draws in hierarchy order, place the mask above the sprites it masks. Turn colour writes on to see it.

- **Type**: mesh (a material's shader); category 2D.
- **Lighting**: none.
- **Inputs**: `uv1`.
- **Default state**: blend opaque, cull off (both faces), depth write off, shadows off, colour write none, stencil always ref 16 write mask 0xf0 pass replace.
- **Depth program**: no (the built-in one).

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alphaCutoff` | range 0 to 1 | 0.5 | Alpha cutoff |

## Outline and stencil

<a id="libraryoutline"></a>
### Outline (`library:outline`)

Inverted-hull outline: the mesh pushed out along its smoothed normal (closed at hard edges) and drawn with its front faces culled, in one colour. Use it as an opaque material's extra pass, order After (Outline (hull) preset): the object's depth hides the inner hull. Not for blended objects: the hull's back faces fill the whole shape, which a blended object (no depth write) shows through Before and is covered by After; the Outline (hull) preset gives a blended material Outline (stencil), Visible only, instead. Width in pixels (constant at any distance, perspective or orthographic) or in world units (optionally growing with distance, capped). Works with skinning, morph targets and instancing; for Sprites use the Sprite shader's Outline feature instead (a flat quad has no hull). No shadows.

- **Type**: mesh (a material's shader); category Outline and stencil.
- **Lighting**: none.
- **Inputs**: `smoothnormals`; `uv1` with `TEXTURE`; `rawcolor` with `VERTEX_COLOR_WIDTH`.
- **Default state**: blend opaque, cull front, depth write on, shadows off.
- **Depth program**: no (the built-in one).

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outlineColor` | HDR colour | (0.02, 0.02, 0.02, 1) | Colour |
| `screenWidth` | range 0 to 32 | 3 | Width (pixels) (with `WIDTH_MODE_SCREEN`) |
| `worldWidth` | float | 0.03 | Width (world units) (with `WIDTH_MODE_WORLD`) |
| `distanceScale` | range 0 to 1 | 1 | Distance scaling (1: constant on-screen size beyond the reference distance) (with `DISTANCE_SCALE`) |
| `referenceDistance` | float | 10 | Reference distance (world width applies up to it) (with `DISTANCE_SCALE`) |
| `maxWidth` | float | 0.25 | Maximum width (world units) (with `DISTANCE_SCALE`) |
| `textureTiling` | vector4 | (1, 1, 0, 0) | Texture tiling (xy) and offset (zw) (with `TEXTURE`) |

| Texture | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `u_outlineTexture` | white | Tint texture (with `TEXTURE`) |

| Feature | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `DISTANCE_SCALE` | off | Grow with distance (world width) |
| `TEXTURE` | off | Tint texture |
| `VERTEX_COLOR_WIDTH` | off | Width times vertex colour red |

| Keyword group | Values (first is the default) | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `WIDTH_MODE` | `WIDTH_MODE_SCREEN`, `WIDTH_MODE_WORLD` | Width in |

<a id="libraryoutline_stencil"></a>
### Outline (stencil) (`library:outline_stencil`)

QuickOutline-style outline that never covers its object: an extra pass After a main material that writes stencil 1 over its whole silhouette (Outline (stencil) preset: stencil always, ref 1, write mask 1, pass and depth-fail replace). Draws the pushed-out mesh where stencil bit 1 is not set. Visibility Always draws it through walls (give the object a sort priority above its occluders, as the preset does, so they draw first); Visible only depth-tests it: the outline of blended objects, which an inverted hull would fill (the Outline (hull) preset on a blended material, whose stencil also writes bit 1 over its draw-once or mask test). Width in pixels or world units, as Outline. Uses stencil bit 0x01. No shadows.

- **Type**: mesh (a material's shader); category Outline and stencil.
- **Lighting**: none.
- **Inputs**: `smoothnormals`; `uv1` with `TEXTURE`; `rawcolor` with `VERTEX_COLOR_WIDTH`.
- **Default state**: blend opaque, cull off (both faces), depth write off, depth test always, shadows off, stencil notequal ref 1 read mask 0x01 write mask 0x00; with `VISIBILITY_VISIBLE_ONLY`: depth write on, depth test less-equal.
- **Depth program**: no (the built-in one).

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outlineColor` | HDR colour | (1, 0.6, 0.1, 1) | Colour |
| `screenWidth` | range 0 to 32 | 4 | Width (pixels) (with `WIDTH_MODE_SCREEN`) |
| `worldWidth` | float | 0.04 | Width (world units) (with `WIDTH_MODE_WORLD`) |
| `distanceScale` | range 0 to 1 | 1 | Distance scaling (1: constant on-screen size beyond the reference distance) (with `DISTANCE_SCALE`) |
| `referenceDistance` | float | 10 | Reference distance (world width applies up to it) (with `DISTANCE_SCALE`) |
| `maxWidth` | float | 0.25 | Maximum width (world units) (with `DISTANCE_SCALE`) |
| `textureTiling` | vector4 | (1, 1, 0, 0) | Texture tiling (xy) and offset (zw) (with `TEXTURE`) |

| Texture | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `u_outlineTexture` | white | Tint texture (with `TEXTURE`) |

| Feature | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `DISTANCE_SCALE` | off | Grow with distance (world width) |
| `TEXTURE` | off | Tint texture |
| `VERTEX_COLOR_WIDTH` | off | Width times vertex colour red |

| Keyword group | Values (first is the default) | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `WIDTH_MODE` | `WIDTH_MODE_SCREEN`, `WIDTH_MODE_WORLD` | Width in |
| `VISIBILITY` | `VISIBILITY_ALWAYS`, `VISIBILITY_VISIBLE_ONLY` | Visibility |

<a id="librarysilhouette"></a>
### Silhouette (`library:silhouette`)

See-through silhouette: draws only the parts of the object hidden behind other objects (depth test greater, no depth write), in a flat colour or a fresnel glow, alpha blended. Use it as a material's extra pass, order Before (See-through silhouette preset), and draw the object after its occluders (the preset gives it sort priority 1). Each pixel blends once: stencil bit 0x02 is set where it draws (overlapping hidden parts do not stack). No shadows.

- **Type**: mesh (a material's shader); category Outline and stencil.
- **Lighting**: none.
- **Inputs**: `position`, `normals` with `SILHOUETTE_MODE_FRESNEL`.
- **Default state**: blend alpha, cull back, depth write off, depth test greater, shadows off, stencil notequal ref 2 read mask 0x02 write mask 0x02 pass replace.
- **Depth program**: no (the built-in one).

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | HDR colour | (0.25, 0.6, 1, 0.6) | Colour (alpha: opacity) |
| `fresnelPower` | range 0.25 to 8 | 2 | Fresnel power (with `SILHOUETTE_MODE_FRESNEL`) |
| `fresnelFill` | range 0 to 1 | 0.15 | Fresnel fill (opacity facing the view) (with `SILHOUETTE_MODE_FRESNEL`) |

| Keyword group | Values (first is the default) | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SILHOUETTE_MODE` | `SILHOUETTE_MODE_FLAT`, `SILHOUETTE_MODE_FRESNEL` | Shading |

<a id="librarystencil_mask"></a>
### Stencil mask (`library:stencil_mask`)

Writes stencil 16 (bits 0xF0) where it draws, and no colour or depth: a portal, window or hole. Objects with a stencil test show only inside it (Visible inside mask preset: equal 16) or only outside it (Visible outside mask: not equal 16). Masks must draw before their readers: in the opaque queue they precede blended readers; give opaque readers a higher sort priority or the mask a lower one (the Stencil mask preset sets -1). Several masks: refs 16, 32 ... 240 under read/write mask 0xF0. Alpha clip cuts the mask's shape from a texture's alpha. Turn colour writes on to see it (Colour).

- **Type**: mesh (a material's shader); category Outline and stencil.
- **Lighting**: none.
- **Inputs**: `uv1` with `ALPHA_CLIP`.
- **Default state**: blend opaque, depth write off, shadows off, colour write none, stencil always ref 16 write mask 0xf0 pass replace.
- **Depth program**: no (the built-in one).

| Property | Kind | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | colour | (1, 0, 1, 1) | Colour (drawn only with colour writes on) |
| `alphaCutoff` | range 0 to 1 | 0.5 | Alpha cutoff (with `ALPHA_CLIP`) |
| `tiling` | vector4 | (1, 1, 0, 0) | Tiling (xy) and offset (zw) (with `ALPHA_CLIP`) |

| Texture | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `u_maskTexture` | white | Mask shape (alpha) (with `ALPHA_CLIP`) |

| Feature | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ALPHA_CLIP` | off | Alpha clip shape |
